# Troubleshooting

If LAN clients cannot reach the Internet, verify:

1. LAN host default gateway
2. ge-0/0/1.0 status
3. ge-0/0/0.0 status
4. Default route
5. ISP gateway reachability
6. Security-zone assignments
7. Source NAT rule match
8. Security policy
9. Session table
10. DNS separately from IP connectivity

---
